lines: ［新娘］我是沙仑的玫瑰花，
是谷中的百合花。
I am a rose of Sharon
a lily of the valleys.
［新娘］我是沙仑的玫瑰花，
是谷中的百合花。
［新娘］我是沙崙的玫瑰花，
是谷中的百合花。
I am a rose of Sharon
a lily of the valleys.
I am a rose of Sharon
a flower of the valleys.
他们说是认识神，行事却和他相背，
本是可憎恶的，是悖逆的，
在各样善事上是可废弃的。
They profess that they know God
but by their deeds they deny him
being abominable
disobedient
and unfit for any good work.
他们说是认识神，行事却和他相背，
本是可憎恶的，是悖逆的，
在各样善事上是可废弃的。
他們說是認識神，行事卻和他相背，
本是可憎惡的，是悖逆的，
在各樣善事上是可廢棄的。
They profess that they know God
but by their deeds they deny him
being abominable
disobedient
and unfit for any good work.
They say that they have knowledge of God
while by their acts they are turning their backs on him; they are hated by all
hard-hearted
and judged to be without value for any good work.
地上万族中，凡不上耶路撒冷敬拜大君王万军之耶和华的，
必无雨降在他们的地上。
It will be
that whoever of all the families of the earth doesn’t go up to Jerusalem to worship the King
Yahweh of Armies
on them there will be no rain.
地上万族中，凡不上耶路撒冷敬拜大君王万军之耶和华的，
必无雨降在他们的地上。
地上萬族中，凡不上耶路撒冷敬拜大君王萬軍之耶和華的，
必無雨降在他們的地上。
It will be
that whoever of all the families of the earth doesn’t go up to Jerusalem to worship the King
Yahweh of Armies
on them there will be no rain.
And it will be that if any one of all the families of the earth does not go up to Jerusalem to give worship to the King
the Lord of armies
on them there will be no rain.
那时，我必使万民用清洁的言语，
好求告我耶和华的名，
同心合意的事奉我。
For then I will purify the lips of the peoples
that they may all call on Yahweh’s name
to serve him shoulder to shoulder.
那时，我必使万民用清洁的言语，
好求告我耶和华的名，
同心合意的事奉我。
那時，我必使萬民用清潔的言語，
好求告我耶和華的名，
同心合意的事奉我。
For then I will purify the lips of the peoples
that they may all call on Yahweh’s name
to serve him shoulder to shoulder.
For then I will give the people a clean language
so that they may all make prayer to the Lord and be his servants with one mind.
